method.grid: one slot per 300 s; first reading per slot; NaN where there is no reading
method.decision_1: wizard records in the window with a typed glucose, ISF and target; truth = CGM reading within 5 min; dose = max(0, (G - target)/ISF - IOB) when G > 'correct above' level
method.decision_2_3: episodes: >= 3 readings (15 min) beyond the threshold start one; >= 3 readings back in range (or no reading) end it; thresholds [70, 54, 180, 200]
method.matching: a faulted alert within +/- 30 min of a true start, or inside the true episode, detects it; others are false alerts
method.risk_indices: Kovatchev: f = 1.509 * ((ln BG)^1.084 - 5.381), r = 10 f^2; LBGI = mean(r | f < 0), HBGI = mean(r | f > 0)
method.meter_truth_sensitivity: truth = typed meter value, faulted = CGM reading * (1 + bias); subset rule in data.wizard.meter_truth_subset
method.aggregation: mean over draws per participant, then median (IQR) across participants; bootstrap CI resamples participants (1000)

meter_truth_subset.rule: CGM+BGM arm, typed value = meter-device reading within 5 min, typed value != nearest CGM reading, meter reading not used for calibration
